title: 雪中花房

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：左偏拱窗外深雪、右侧皇后、前景暖毯卧鹿与果篮麦穗可辨；仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque full-canvas 1024x1536 vertical Empress tarot master, theme 雪中花房 / Winter Flowerhouse. Reference image provides queen identity and tarot style: exactly one dark-haired flower-crowned queen in ivory gown and soft plum cloak, holding one rose, with exactly one peacefully reclining spotted fawn, one fruit basket, and wheat stalks. Invent a glass greenhouse overflowing with gentle plants while deep snow lies outside. Greenhouse arched window axis left of center; queen seated RIGHT, deer rests on a warm rug in near foreground. White-green, warm blush pink, pale gold palette, natural skin. Show chair legs, tiled floor, rug and basket all in correct physical contact, with solid floor going into bottom bleed. Rose, wheat, fruit and deer remain individually clear. Luminous painterly fantasy tarot, delicate gold celestial border, spatially layered plants and snowy landscape beyond glass. No duplicate animals or people, no typography, title, letters, logo or watermark. Opaque complete image for later splitting.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

generationRuns.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. ISOLATED DECORATION ONLY: 少量花瓣. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main props, ALL buildings, ALL ground/floor/platforms, ALL borders and corner ornaments. Only a FEW small separate decorative elements at the original positions, preserving large empty center. If absent, create a sparse matching-style candidate. Every other pixel must be solid #FF00FF; no gradient or texture in key background. NO HUMAN, NO ANIMAL, NO SCENERY, NO FRAME. Do not turn the whole reference into a cutout of its subject. This is the small decorative overlay only. IMPORTANT: EXCLUDE the reference card edge stars, crescents, corner icons and any frame filigree. The requested light flecks/leaves are NEW independent small foreground particles, NOT edge furniture. Distribute 6 to 12 tiny separate elements at lateral sides, no central figure and no center emblem.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
